  1 ≤ t →

            QuarticQuery.mValue t + (QuarticQuery.mValue t - 1) + 40 * t * (C.size + 2) ∧
          Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) ≤
              (42 + 20 * A) * QuarticQuery.mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 3 ∧
            (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)) (i : QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t))
                (s : QuarticQuery.Address (40 * t)),
                QuarticQuery.PaperWinsAt (QuarticQuery.P k t) C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s ↔
                  ∀ (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                    QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e = Bool.true) ∧
              (∀ (i : QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (40 * t))
                  (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                  (∀
                      (x :
                        QuarticQuery.BitInput
                          (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),
                      (QuarticQuery.localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).eval x =
                        QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e) ∧
                    (QuarticQuery.localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).depth ≤ 2 * t + 1) ∧
                ∀ (i : QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (40 * t)),
                  ∃ Z instZ,
                    have x := instZ;
                    ∃ o out F,
                      (∀ (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                          QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (Max.max 3 (2 * t + 1)) (F e)) ∧
                        (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (Max.max 3 (2 * t + 1)) fun x_1 =>
                            QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1) ∧
                          (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                              (a : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size → ℂ)
                              (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                              (QuarticQuery.Upper.slice e)
                                  ((QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1)
                                    (QuarticQuery.Paper.constructionIndexStart o a)) =
                                a e • (F e x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket (o e))) ∧
                            (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                                (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) (z : Z e),
                                out e z ≠ QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x_1 i s e →
                                  ((F e x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket (o e))).ofLp z = 0) ∧
                              ∃ w emb P,
                                ∀ (next : QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C) w),
                                  (P next).queryCap ≤ 2 * (2 * t + 1) + next.queryCap ∧
                                    ∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                                      (ψ :
                                        QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg
                                          ((e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) × Z e))
                                      (b : Bool),
                                      (P next).outputMass x_1 ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ψ) b =
                                        next.outputMass x_1
                                          ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb)
                                            ((QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1) ψ))
                                          b
